title: Mon 11/23: A diet ends. A plan does not.
why: November is not planned yet; this keeps the FB/IG cadence going

payload.title: Mon 11/23: A diet ends. A plan does not.
payload.purpose: The difference between diet culture and behavioral treatment: skills that hold up on a bad week.

captions.FB:
A diet ends the moment you have a hard week. A behavioral plan does not.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we teach coping skills that hold up when life gets difficult. Recovery and goal setting. Mindful eating. Family engagement. Behavioral therapy and counseling. Dietary guidance and support. Culinary classes. Mindful movement. One program, not four.

We serve people who struggle with weight loss, binge eating and chronic overeating. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Link in the first comment.
